{{Quote|What is the Force?|The opening line and summary question of the journal|<ref name="BOS" />}}
'''''The Science of Creating Life''''' was a scientific journal written by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], documenting [[Gender/Legends|his]] experimentation and research concerning [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as well as his musing on its true nature. The information contained in the journal revolutionized [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] understanding of the relationship between the Force and biological science.

==Sections==
*''Influencing the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|Midi-chlorians]]''
*''Perpetual Life''
*''Concentrating the Force''
*''The Philosophy of Life''
*''New Explorations in the Force''
*''Transcending Death''
*''The Netherworld and Chaos''
*''Sith Spirits''
*''The Prophecy of the Chosen One''
*''The Culmination of the [[Sith'ari/Legends|Sith'ari]]''

==History==
Upon Plagueis's [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], his possessions, including the journal, came to be owned by his former student and murderer, who collected them along with other Sith records into the ''[[Book of Sith]]''. After Sidious died on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] acquired the book, recording, in turn, his own notes.
